invariants.rationale: Since the method body always throws an exception and never returns, result can only be null at any exit (i.e., normal exit is impossible; but symbolically, result is always null).
This method always throws an exception, so no execution reaches a normal return; thus, the method exit is unreachable and 'false' is a valid invariant.
Method would not reach normal exit path; if it ever did, the incoming parameter would still be non-null unless specified otherwise.
instantTime would only be null if passed as null, and its value is not altered; if method could return, the invariant still stands.
context can only be null if passed as null; value is not assigned in method, so invariant holds if method could return.
